# datev-mcp

> MCP server for DATEV accounting workflows — connect AI agents to German accounting data.

An open-source [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server that enables AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to work with DATEV accounting data: parse EXTF files, look up SKR03/SKR04 chart of accounts, create booking entries, and generate DATEV-compliant exports.

**Offline-first.** No DATEV account required. No approval process.

---

## Features

- **EXTF file handling** — read, validate, and generate DATEV EXTF booking files
- **SKR03 & SKR04** — query the standard German charts of accounts (137+ / 89+ accounts)
- **Booking entries** — create and validate DATEV-compliant booking entries
- **AI suggestions** — rule-based account suggestions from invoice text

---

## Quick Start

### Claude Desktop

Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "datev": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": ["datev-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Local Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/BadRix90/datev-mcp
cd datev-mcp
uv venv && uv sync --extra dev
uv run python -m datev_mcp.server
```

### HTTP Mode

```bash
uv run python -m datev_mcp.server --transport http
# Server runs on http://localhost:8080
```

---

## Available MCP Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `datev_buchung_erstellen` | Create a DATEV booking entry with validation |
| `datev_buchung_vorschlagen` | Suggest accounts from invoice text |
| `datev_extf_lesen` | Read and parse an EXTF file |
| `datev_extf_validieren` | Validate an EXTF file for DATEV compliance |
| `datev_extf_exportieren` | Export booking entries as EXTF file |
| `datev_kontenrahmen_suchen` | Search SKR03/SKR04 chart of accounts |
| `datev_kontenrahmen_info` | Get details for a specific account number |

## MCP Resources

| URI | Content |
|-----|---------|
| `datev://kontenrahmen/skr03/{nr}` | SKR03 account details |
| `datev://kontenrahmen/skr04/{nr}` | SKR04 account details |

---

## Demo

### Web Demo

```bash
uv run python demo/server.py
# Open http://localhost:8090
```

Interactive wizard that demonstrates the AI agent workflow: invoice processing, account lookup, and EXTF export — all powered by real MCP tool calls.

### CLI Demo

```bash
uv run python demo/mockup.py
```

Runs 5 scenarios showing how an AI agent would interact with the DATEV MCP server.

---

## Architecture

```
Phase 1 (current): Offline-first
+-----------+    MCP    +------------+
| AI Agent  | --------> | datev-mcp  |
| (Claude)  |           | Server     |
+-----------+           +-----+------+
                              |
                        +-----v------+
                        | EXTF Parser|
                        | SKR03/04   |
                        | (local)    |
                        +------------+

Phase 2 (planned): DATEV API integration via OAuth 2.0
```

---

## Configuration

| Environment Variable | Description | Default |
|---------------------|-------------|---------|
| `DATEV_MCP_LOG_LEVEL` | Log level (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING) | `INFO` |
| `DATEV_MCP_TRANSPORT` | Transport type (stdio/http) | `stdio` |
| `DATEV_MCP_PORT` | HTTP port (http transport only) | `8080` |

Copy `.env.example` to `.env` to configure.

---

## Development

```bash
# Run tests
uv run pytest

# Lint & format
uv run ruff check .
uv run ruff format .
```

**Requirements:** Python >= 3.12, [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)

---

## Tech Stack

- [FastMCP](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp) 3.1.0 — MCP server framework
- [Pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev/) v2 — data validation
- [Ruff](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/) — linting & formatting
- [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) — testing
